unit.why: An anecdote about the Berdichever rebbe visiting the Seer of Lublin: the coffee-and-milk episode, his permission to Lublin to speak of ruah ha-kodesh, and the son R. Yosef's question.
unit.boundary_note: previous division ends with an opening stub 'פ״א הה"ק מלובלין זצ"ל' that probably belongs to this story or is a misplaced catchword

stories.start_quote: פ״א הי׳ הה״ק מבארדיטשוב אצל הה״ק מלובלין
stories.end_quote: שאניך רוח הקודש גם מכאן ולהלאה
stories.summary_en: When the Berdichever visits the Seer of Lublin, he asks that milk be poured before coffee for the gematria of 'mikveh'. He then confronts the Seer about speaking of ruah ha-kodesh and gives him permission. The Seer tells his son R. Yosef that he knew by ruah ha-kodesh that the Berdichever would agree.
